syncSegmentsEn.text: If one day you feel your courage slipping away
If one day you truly want to give up
If one day you feel that nobody loves you
If one day it feels as though you’ve hit rock bottom
On that day, take heart again
On that day, be kind to yourself
On that day, remember that someone loves you
On that day, do not give up too easily
There truly is a God in this world
He loves you and wants to help you
Though you feel lonely in a sea of people
His love can warm even the coldest indifference
There truly is a God in this world
He longs to hold you close in His arms
He will walk with you through the long night
He loves you and will stay with you all your life
